mentions.name: Reveal
mentions.description: Open-source color separation engine for screen printing that reduces a full-color image to 3-10 spot colors (not CMYK or simulated process). The core is pure, zero-dependency JavaScript working in Lab color space using Wu quantization, CIE perceptual distance metrics, and a DNA fingerprinting system that matches each image to one of 20+ built-in archetypes (Golden Hour, Dark Portrait, Fine Art Scan, etc.). Includes a browser-based web UI (requires Node.js) where you drop an image and get 4 possible separations side by side, exportable as layered OpenRaster (GIMP/Krita), flat PNG, or layered PSD (Photoshop), plus a CLI and Photoshop plugin. Apache 2.0 licensed.
